answer: A canyon lotus sponsor-decay bond stops fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits under a sponsor who stakes 100; both enter a canyon ledger. The sponsor renews before each horizon; each idle epoch adds one wilt mark to the lotus bed, and three marks slash the stake and burn the bond. A rented-sponsor ring forging 1,000 identities locks 170,000 credits, and one sponsor backs at most three agents, so it needs 334 sponsors. Honest agents pay 70 once.
